interpretation: Small, unstable differences around 1%-2% are treated as noise, not as a confidence interval.
notes: Only OutputParser._scan changed in production; baseline includes all preceding parser optimizations.

Complete parameter followers are already verified, so str.find advances past their whitespace.

Native source and binary are unchanged. The existing offset-aware SIMD scanner is reused.
98 native tests passed; fallback 95 passed plus 3 skips; 24432 differential comparisons agree.
The first prototype added 2.85%-6.20% in its three long-string cases and was replaced.
Native 10-parameter whole input had one +43.34% anomaly with spikes in all arms; focused checks gave -3.95%/-1.37%. Original result retained.
